proxy_definition: Coulomb-counted SOC proxy may use measured QDischarge from the current mission and the latest completed earlier RPT capacity; use nominal 3 Ah only until the first valid RPT.
causal_rule: Do not use the current RPT result to label its own cycle or interpolate future capacity backward. An RPT capacity becomes available only after that test completes.
limitations: No independent electrochemical SOC or BMS SOC label is supplied.
A Q-based target is a reference proxy, not ground truth; MAE against it is not true-SOC accuracy.
Low-rate RPT capacity is not the same as high-rate mission-accessible capacity.
A mission discharge endpoint is not SOC=0; mission profiles leave residual capacity.
SOC during charging requires an estimated start SOC and charge-efficiency assumption.
rpt_candidate_rule: A contiguous low-rate tail candidate has cumulative QDischarge >=1 Ah, mean current from -1.0 to -0.3 A, duration >=3000 s, and minimum voltage <=2.6 V. A >=1000 s sensitivity set is also exported. Candidate cycles require manual protocol review against README anomalies and impedance records.
cycle_index_note: charge_cycle_index counts sustained contiguous Ns=0 segments (>100 s) and is an ordering proxy; it is not the raw tester cycleNumber and may drift when phases are missing or malformed.
